name: Pink Kush
summary: **Pink Kush** is a clone-only [[kind:cut|cut]] of [[og-kush|OG Kush]] that emerged in British Columbia, [[country:CA|Canada]], in the 1990s and early 2000s. Growers isolated and preserved the phenotype through cloning rather than seed, and it became a widely grown cultivar across Western Canada, gaining broader distribution after Canada's 2018 legalization.
